topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: Oh, I don't know, I really don't. It's just that your yard is this tiny square of heaven you've been nurturing for so long, and suddenly it's about to get a whole new aspect. I mean, it's not that I don't trust you or anything. It's just, well, the last time someone did that, it ended up looking like a patch of wilderness instead of a garden. But hey, if you're really into it, and you’re sure you know what you’re doing, who am I to say no? I guess I should be excited for you, right? It’s a chance to grow something together, maybe even stronger because of it. Let’s just make sure we water it more than we water down what we’ve built here, okay?
